This is part one of Moonshots — a new Charts & Crafts series in partnership with Smartsheet where each company is taking a massive swing. They're either going to totally change the world…or not.
 
Etched isn't only making chips. They're making whole data center racks built specifically for AI inference, which is way, way harder.
 
Here's why it's a prize worth shooting for:

7505989379107020800.text:
NVIDIA's CUDA used to be a good reason to not consider alternative silicon.

It was a real moat for NVIDIA for the past few years. 

If you wanted alternative silicon to run training, you had to rebuild years of software from scratch before your first model.

Over the past 6 months, that has changed: 

1/ You can write your own compiler now, and AI coding gets you to something quickly that is at the very least workable. 

2/ The chip companies have stopped treating software as an afterthought.
